quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on head coach taking responsibility for team's poor performance
quotes.excerpt: we're all pros and we got to get ourselves ready for games at the end of the day

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The coach kind of put tonight on him. He said this was his he didn't prepare you guys enough, he didn't do enough to get you guys ready. I guess just in this mindset of get better together, to have the head coach kind of just put that on his shoulders, I guess, what does that mean for you all when it's a tough night like tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyler Herro
text_blocks.text: It's good to hear that, but at the same time I feel like we're all pros and we got to get ourselves ready for games at the end of the day. We're a young team, but it's a learning experience for everybody. It's a learning curve, but like I said, we're all pros and I feel like as players we should be able to come in with the right mindset, the right approach to every game. That's what we get paid to do.

quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro says while it is good to hear the coach take responsibility for a loss, the players need to take accountability. We are all pros and we should be able to come in with the right mindset and the right approach to every game.

structured.context: Tyler Herro reacts to his head coach taking responsibility for the team's poor performance after a loss.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the team's struggles and defensive challenges against Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: continue to work for the right shots, continue to share the ball

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Second quarter, it felt like nothing could go in. Layups, open looks. Just as it may happen, but it can't translate to the other end. Is that kind of how you saw that pivotal second quarter?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyler Herro
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I mean, got to continue to work for the right shots, continue to share the ball. When things do get tough, when guys may miss a couple shots, continue to work the offense, continue to do the things that we work on in practice. And defense, yeah, we're playing a good team over there. They got Kevin Durant, he's a Hall of Famer. Frey Van Fleet, a veteran who's been in this league for a while. But at the end of the day, like I said, we just got to play the right way and continue to stick to how we want to play both on both sides.

quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro on the team's struggles against a tough opponent like Kevin Durant and the Suns. We just have to play the right way and continue to stick to how we want to play on both sides of the ball.

structured.context: Tyler Herro discusses the team's offensive struggles and the challenge of defending against Kevin Durant and Fred VanVleet.
